name: Daily Activity Revenue
query:
SELECT REV.OP_Services AS "OP SERVICES", REV.MSA, REV.PAN, REV.TOTS AS "Service Totals"
FROM
(
    SELECT 
    	CASE WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4010 - Consultation Outpatient Fees - GCH" THEN "OP Consultation"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4002 - Drugs Income - GCH" OR `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4514 - Service Charge - GCH" THEN "Pharmacy Sales"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4007 - Laboratory Fees - GCH" THEN "Laboratory"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4307 - OPD Nursing Procedures - GCH" THEN "Outpatient Procedures"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4051 - Well Baby Clinic - GCH" THEN "Well Baby"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4065 - Dental Clinic - GCH" THEN "Dental"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4067 - Specialist Pediatric Clinic - GCH" THEN "Specialist Paediatric"
    		 WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4068 - Nutrition Clinic - GCH" THEN "Nutritionist"
    		 ELSE "Other Services"
    	END AS "OP_Services", /*`tabSales Invoice Item`.amount AS "Amount"*/
    	SUM(CASE WHEN branch = "Mombasa" THEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.amount ELSE 0 END) as "MSA",
    	SUM(CASE WHEN branch = "Pangani" THEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.amount ELSE 0 END) as "PAN", 
    	SUM(`tabSales Invoice Item`.amount) as "TOTS"
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` 
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` ON  `tabSales Invoice Item`.parent = `tabSales Invoice`.name
    WHERE `tabSales Invoice`.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND `tabSales Invoice`.status IN("Paid","Unpaid","Partly Paid", "Overdue") 
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4010 - Consultation Outpatient Fees - GCH" THEN "Consultation"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4002 - Drugs Income - GCH" OR `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4514 - Service Charge - GCH" THEN "Pharmacy Sales"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4007 - Laboratory Fees - GCH" THEN "Laboratory"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4307 - OPD Nursing Procedures - GCH" THEN "Outpatient Procedures"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4051 - Well Baby Clinic - GCH" THEN "Well Baby"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4065 - Dental Clinic - GCH" THEN "Dental"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4067 - Specialist Pediatric Clinic - GCH" THEN "Specialist Paediatric"
    		    WHEN `tabSales Invoice Item`.income_account = "4068 - Nutrition Clinic - GCH" THEN "Nutritionist"
    		    ELSE "Other Services"
    		 END
	) AS REV
GROUP BY REV.OP_Services
